Messages.Author: Gregory
Messages.Body:
Question: Does Eternal Vigilance act like a permanant Eagles Sight? Does
this allow you to Block any action (provided that you meet the
intercept)?

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Gregory" <PrinceOfP...@mac.com> a écrit dans le message news:
3A98BFC8...@mac.com...

> Question: Does Eternal Vigilance act like a permanant Eagles Sight? Does
> this allow you to Block any action (provided that you meet the
> intercept)?

you can only untap to block actions you're already allowed to block because
blocking is mandatory. i.e. You can't untap via eternal vigilance to "cross
table intercept" a political action, even if you've got an eagle sight in
hand. Feel free to use a Wake or a Froced.

now imagine Anneke clan impersonating in toreador antitribu, having Cardinal
benediction played on her, she has the option to untap with Eternal
vigilance no matter who's acting, because his special ability says she can
attempt to block every action.

reyda
